description: This file defines the interface and data structures for managing a stack of reftables, including functions for creating, modifying, iterating, and compacting reftable stacks within a version control system.

methods.name: reftable_new_stack
methods.description: Creates a new reftable stack associated with a directory, using specified write options.

methods.name: reftable_stack_next_update_index
methods.description: Retrieves the update index for the next table to be written.

methods.name: reftable_stack_new_addition
methods.description: Starts a new transaction to add reftables to the stack, locking the database.

methods.name: reftable_addition_add
methods.description: Adds a table to the current transaction.

methods.name: reftable_addition_commit
methods.description: Commits a transaction, finalizing the addition of tables.

methods.name: reftable_addition_destroy
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a transaction.

methods.name: reftable_stack_add
methods.description: Adds a new reftable directly to the stack, handling locking and transaction setup.

methods.name: reftable_stack_init_ref_iterator
methods.description: Initializes an iterator to traverse refs in the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_init_log_iterator
methods.description: Initializes an iterator to traverse logs in the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_merged_table
methods.description: Gets the merged table representing the current state for seeking.

methods.name: reftable_stack_destroy
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_reload
methods.description: Reloads the stack if it is out-of-date to ensure consistency.

methods.name: reftable_stack_compact_all
methods.description: Compacts all reftables into a single table, optionally expiring reflog entries.

methods.name: reftable_stack_compaction_required
methods.description: Checks if reftable compaction is needed based on heuristics or other criteria.

methods.name: reftable_stack_auto_compact
methods.description: Performs heuristic-based auto-compaction of the table stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_clean
methods.description: Deletes stale .ref tables to reclaim space.

methods.name: reftable_stack_read_ref
methods.description: Reads a specific reference from the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_read_log
methods.description: Reads a specific log entry from the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_compaction_stats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics related to past compaction activities.

methods.name: reftable_stack_hash_id
methods.description: Returns a hash identifying the current state of the stack.

ctags.name: attempts
ctags.pattern: /^	int attempts; \/* how often we tried to compact *\/$/

ctags.name: bytes
ctags.pattern: /^	uint64_t bytes; \/* total number of bytes written *\/$/

ctags.name: entries_written
ctags.pattern: /^	uint64_t entries_written; \/* total number of entries written, including$/

ctags.name: failures
ctags.pattern: /^	int failures; \/* failures happen on concurrent updates *\/$/
